mapper.insert: insert into user_account(login_name, password_hash, display_name, phone, role_code, venue_id, status) values (#{loginName}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{phone}, #{roleCode}, #{venueId}, #{status})
mapper.select: select id, login_name, password_hash, display_name, phone, role_code, venue_id, status from user_account where login_name = #{loginName} and password_hash = #{passwordHash}
select id, login_name, password_hash, display_name, phone, role_code, venue_id, status from user_account where login_name = #{loginName}
